```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |> 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ "both",
    chocolate ~ "chocolate",
    fruity ~ "fruity",
    .default = "other"
  ))

count(candy, type)
```

### Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Candies"

list(
  icon = "basket",
  color = "warning",
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Number of Fruity Candies"

list(
  icon = "heart-fill",
  color = "secondary",
  value = sum(candy$type == "fruity"))


```

## Row 2 

# Sugar Rush: Does More Sugar Mean More Popular?

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(fivethirtyeight)

# sugarpercent is a 0-1 percentile, so convert to 0-100 for readability
candy <- candy_rankings |>
  mutate(sugar_pct = sugarpercent * 100,
         price_pct = pricepercent * 100)

most_sugary  <- candy |> slice_max(sugar_pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
least_sugary <- candy |> slice_min(sugar_pct, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
sugar_cor    <- cor(candy$sugar_pct, candy$winpercent)

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Most sugary candy"
list(icon = "cup-straw",
     color = "danger",
     value = paste0(most_sugary$competitorname, " (", round(most_sugary$sugar_pct), "th pct)"))

```
